settings.titleDesc: Untainted-node count subtracts distinct nodes carrying non-system taints from the real node inventory. Multiple taints on one node count once. No taints means all inventoried nodes are untainted; missing node inventory stays No data. Taint-detail queries A/D stay empty when there are no matching taints.
集群节点数，节点POD数，节点POD上限

Resource and Pod-count totals include bound Pending/Running/Unknown Pods, including active Jobs. Completed/failed operational Pods are excluded by current Pod UID. Requests are scheduling reservations; limits are burst allowances, not actual usage. Containers without limits are not a healthy zero or a whole-node memory guarantee.
